items.title: Are Calibrated Decision Models Calibrated on Markets? Geolocated News, Markov Switching and a System One Model for Nasdaq-100 Allocation
items.raw_text: Portfolio allocation is driven by probabilities of losses, not only by forecasts of the direction (up/down) of the market. A decision model such as Jev returns a probability for a yes/no question and has been reported to be well calibrated on a set of benchmarks. However, the model's calibration against realised market outcomes has not been tested. In this study, every Friday we ask whether the Nasdaq-100 will close lower four weeks later and compare a two-regime Markov-switching model estimated on data from 1990 to 2026, Jev reading weekly headlines and geolocated news features computed with spatial queries in PostGIS, and their combination. A knowledge probe shows that Jev knows events up to late 2024, so we evaluate it on 88 weeks from January 2025 onwards. None of the models predicts the direction better than the historical base rate. A key finding is that raw Jev overestimates the probability of a decline: its mean forecast is 0.48 against an observed frequency of 0.38, and its ECE is 0.10. A prior shift to the historical base rate, which uses no outcomes from the test period, lowers the ECE to 0.015. In contrast, Platt scaling, isotonic regression and the combination with the Markov model all make the forecasts worse. In a half-Kelly allocation, the raw Jev strategy returns 3.1% per year, whereas after the prior shift it returns 14.5%; a simple buy-and-hold strategy in QQQ returns 15.3% per year. The Markov model forecasts large declines (more than 10%) well, with an AUC of 0.81, and its strategy has the highest Sharpe ratio over 1999-2026. Asked about such a large decline (base rate 4%), raw Jev forecasts 16-24% on average, and the same prior shift removes this offset. The practical lesson is that decision-model probabilities must be anchored to the base rate of the market event before they are used to size positions.

items.one_line_summary: LLM 决策模型 Jev 在纳指下跌概率上过度自信：ECE 0.10，按历史基率平移后降至 0.015
items.technical_summary: 要解决的是 LLM 决策模型输出的下跌概率能否直接用于纳指仓位。方法上每周五问 Jev“四周后纳指是否收低”，并与 1990-2026 估计的两状态 Markov 模型、PostGIS 地理定位新闻特征及二者组合对比，测试期为 2025 年起 88 周。方向预测上没有任何模型超过历史基率；Jev 原始下跌概率均值 0.48，实际频率 0.38，ECE=0.10，按历史基率做先验平移后 ECE 降至 0.015，而 Platt、isotonic 和 Markov 组合反而更差。半凯利下原始 Jev 年化 3.1%，先验平移后 14.5%，仍低于 QQQ 的 15.3%；Markov 对 >10% 下跌的 AUC=0.81，并在 1999-2026 有最高夏普。
key_points: Jev 原始下跌概率均值 0.48，实际仅 0.38；先验平移把 ECE 从 0.10 压到 0.015，半凯利年化 3.1% 升至 14.5%。
可直接复现的只有先验平移公式；Jev 与 PostGIS 新闻特征不公开，88 周样本外需自建周频纳指数据。
仅 88 周、单一纳指且未计交易成本；14.5% 仍低于 QQQ 15.3%，方向预测未超历史基率，不能当 alpha。

items.title: Self-Supervised Learning with Recursive Quadrature Filters for Neural Time Series
items.raw_text: We develop self-supervised methods for training Recursive Quadrature Filter (RQF) encoders on unlabeled time series. RQFs are biologically motivated, complex-valued temporal filters that form a special class of diagonal state-space models (SSMs). Each RQF acts as a band-pass filter whose selectivity is determined by two learnable parameters: its tuning frequency and bandwidth. We separately introduce a self-supervised learning objective based on prediction error; the encoder is trained so that its current state predicts its own future activity. In the windowed mode, the summary of the current window predicts the summary of a later window; in the dense mode, the state at the current timestep predicts future log-power. Each RQF encoder is pretrained on a dataset and then a readout (e.g., a task-specific classifier) is trained on the output of the RQF encoder, with the encoder either frozen or fully fine-tuned. For multichannel EEG and intracranial recordings, a shared encoder processes each channel separately, and a spatial readout combines the channel representations using electrode locations. Across four neural benchmarks using scalp or intracranial EEG, the pretrained RQF system performs close to the state of the art while using a small fraction of the parameters of the competing models. For example, a 110k-parameter RQF system achieves 0.9247 +/- 0.0022 test AUROC on 100-s TUAB segments, above SAMBA (0.9054) at the same context with 9 times as many parameters, and 0.9040 +/- 0.0019 on 10-s segments, comparable to EEG foundation models with 3.2M-369M parameters.

items.one_line_summary: 11 万参数的可学习带通滤波器编码器用自监督预测误差预训练，EEG 异常检测 AUROC 0.9247 超越 9 倍参数对手——同类对角状态空间模型可直接当金融时序的轻量特征提取层
items.technical_summary: 标注时序稀缺、大模型训练成本高，需要一个参数极省、可无标签预训练的时间序列编码器。做法是把每个 RQF 单元设计成复数域带通滤波器（对角状态空间模型的特例），只有两个可学习参数：调谐频率和带宽，因此隐状态可以 O(1) 递推更新。自监督目标是预测误差：窗口模式用当前窗口的摘要预测后续窗口的摘要，稠密模式用 t 时刻状态预测未来 log-power。多通道输入时共享编码器逐通道处理，再用基于电极坐标的空间读出层融合。在四个头皮 / 颅内 EEG 基准上，110k 参数系统在 100 s TUAB 片段取得 0.9247±0.0022 AUROC，高于 9 倍参数 SAMBA 的 0.9054；10 s 片段 0.9040±0.0019，与 3.2M–369M 参数的 EEG 基础模型持平。

items.title: FOREST: Coordinating Tree-based HBF, RRAM, and HBM for Efficient Speculative LLM Inference
items.raw_text: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by combining lightweight drafting with parallel target-model verification. However, its stages impose distinct resource demands: target verification requires high-throughput access to large weight sets, sequential drafting executes a compact model under tight latency constraints, and long-context attention processes growing key-value (KV) caches. Conventional GPU-centric SD systems serve these workloads through shared HBM-centric memory and general-purpose compute, creating mismatches in capacity, bandwidth, and computation. These mismatches constrain deployable model-context configurations and limit the efficiency of bandwidth-bound and latency-sensitive operations. We propose FOREST, a heterogeneous memory-centric architecture coordinating HBF, 3D-stacked RRAM, and HBM memory-compute trees for efficient SD. It features: (1) compute-aligned 3D RRAM, combining ultra-wide, low-frequency reads with clock-decoupled interfaces and overlapped SRAM-DCIM weight refills for latency-sensitive drafting; (2) cross-tree numerical co-design, moving block-scaled Q/K/V preprocessing to HBF and RRAM root plates and enabling block-floating-point (BFP) attention with pipelined softmax reduction in the HBM tree; and (3) HBF-aware SD design-space exploration, revealing how bandwidth-compute provisioning and model scale determine performance, energy, and cost trade-offs. Evaluated across six SD configurations spanning 32B-405B target models, FOREST achieves up to 5.5x end-to-end speedup, 11.46x higher decode throughput, and 16.5x higher decode energy efficiency over NVIDIA A800 GPU-based SD baselines. Under a modeled total cost of ownership, FOREST delivers up to 6.73x higher token-generation cost efficiency.

items.title: Distributional Deep Hedging
items.raw_text: Deep hedging learns a hedging strategy by optimising a risk preference over a neural-network policy. The preference is fixed before training, so each new preference requires a new policy and, in actor-critic methods, a new critic. We propose distributional deep hedging, in which the distribution of the hedging profit and loss is learned through its quantiles and the risk preference is applied afterwards, as a weight on those quantiles. We characterise the preferences that admit this representation, which include expected shortfall and its mixtures, and show that the entropic utility is computed from the same quantiles. At the current policy, each of these preferences is bounded below by an expected utility with the same gradient. This bound reduces risk-sensitive hedging to a sequence of risk-neutral problems, from which we derive policy-search and actor-critic algorithms. In numerical experiments, the learned hedges approach references computed by dynamic programming, and a single distributional critic trained without a preference can serve preferences chosen after training.

items.one_line_summary: 用分位数学习对冲 P&L 分布、风险偏好训练后加权：一个 distributional critic 服务任意 expected shortfall 偏好，数值实验逼近动态规划基准
items.technical_summary: 传统 deep hedging 把风险偏好（如 expected shortfall）固定进网络策略里，换一个偏好就得重训 policy 甚至 critic。这项工作改为先学对冲损益的整个分布——用分位数（quantile）表示——再把风险偏好作为训练后对这些分位数的加权函数施加。作者刻画了能这样表示的偏好类（含 expected shortfall 及其混合），并证明熵效用也能由同一组分位数算出；在当前策略处，这类偏好被一个同梯度的期望效用从下方界定，从而把风险敏感对冲降为一系列风险中性问题，导出 policy-search 与 actor-critic 算法。数值实验中学习到的对冲策略逼近动态规划算出的参考解，且一个不带偏好训练好的 distributional critic 可直接服务训练后选定的偏好。
key_points: 核心思路是把对冲 P&L 分布用分位数参数化、偏好后置加权，理论覆盖 expected shortfall 及其混合；原文摘要未给出夏普、收益或误差的具体数值，只称数值实验逼近动态规划参考解，量化结论待复核。
可用性强于传统 deep hedging：一次训练得到 distributional critic 即可在期望短缺等偏好间切换，避免换偏好重训；但需分位数回归/分布型 RL 实现经验，摘要未提代码或数据需求。
仅有摘要与理论陈述，无样本外测试、无交易成本/滑点假设、无与经典对冲基线的具体量化对比，且偏好可表示类的边界条件需在实盘约束下验证。

items.title: Hierarchical Agentic Mid-Band Agility for Reliable Low-Latency Space-Air-Ground Integrated V2X Networks
items.raw_text: Upper-mid-band spectrum offers bandwidth opportunities for the integrated networks of ground vehicles, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites to support 6G wide-area vehicle-to-everything (V2X) connectivity. However, V2X services' latency and reliability are sensitive to the mid-band selection due to frequency-dependent propagation and rain attenuation. This paper investigates environment-aware spectrum agility over candidate frequency range 3 (FR3) bands within 7.125-24.25 GHz, jointly with end-to-end (E2E) multi-path traffic splitting and transmit power control. Each data packet is partitioned into non-overlapping subflows over direct and UAV-assisted paths, with failed sky-link subflows selectively retransmitted subject to retransmission and freshness constraints. We formulate latency- and reliability-oriented problems, followed by a unified sequential optimization problem incorporating band-switching costs and average quality-of-service (QoS) violation budgets. To coordinate optimization decisions across heterogeneous timescales, we develop an agentic AI-assisted hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning (AA-HMARL) framework. A high-level agentic supervisor integrates recurrent memory, analytical evaluation of candidate bands, and event-triggered replanning to coordinate slow environmental adaptation with fast channel and retransmission dynamics, while distributed ground vehicles and UAV agents optimize data splitting and power using constrained MAPPO. Simulation results demonstrate an adjustable reliability-latency trade-off. Particularly, AA-HMARL reduces the mean E2E completion latency and the mean number of retransmission rounds among successfully delivered updates by 17.8-25.5% and 57.6-61.5%, respectively, and reduces the mean age of information (AoI) by 12.7-14.6% relative to fixed-band MAPPO across two traffic types.

items.title: Preserving Pretrained CFG Structure in RL for Diffusion Models with Conditional Contrast Regularization
items.raw_text: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important component in the post-training of diffusion models. In practice, however, standard RL often improves the target reward without reliably preserving holistic generation quality, leading to unstable reward-quality trade-offs that we view as a form of reward hacking. Since Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is known to improve visual clarity, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality in generation, we investigate whether its underlying structure can serve as a useful prior during RL. We present a unified geometric view that interprets both CFG and RL as correction vectors in a common prediction space, and identify the projection of the RL-induced correction onto the pretrained CFG correction as a useful diagnostic of quality-related structural preservation. Geometric analysis and rotation intervention further show that the pretrained CFG direction carries information useful for generation quality that reward-driven RL updates do not necessarily preserve. Based on this insight, we propose Conditional Contrast Regularization (CCR), which uses the frozen reference model's conditional contrast as a local structural prior during RL. Experiments across multiple reward settings and backbones show that CCR more consistently preserves generation quality while maintaining competitive reward, yielding a better reward-quality trade-off than standard RL and generic regularization methods.

items.title: Reward Integrity in Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for LLM Guardrail Red-Teaming
items.raw_text: We study reward fidelity in an adversarial reinforcement-learning loop for red-teaming financial-services language-model guardrails. Apparent wins can arise when an attack omits prescribed personally identifiable information (PII), or when a reward judge credits a response that did not break the targeted policy. On attacker-generated and public benchmark examples, TypeSafe Jev checks whether the prescribed PII is present. For outcome scoring, we compare the decision models TypeSafe Jev, Laya (pretrained and post-trained), and pretrained CLM-8B with logged Opus 4.8 judgements from a replay corpus. Post-training markedly improves Laya's agreement with the judge. A separate author-reviewed off-target set establishes that Opus can award false wins. The findings motivate specialised decision-model judges for checking prescribed PII in attack inputs and scoring target responses against the intended policy.

items.title: Auditing Post-Training Unlearning in Diffusion Language Models using Sparse Autoencoders
items.raw_text: Machine unlearning is an approach to privacy protection: it aims to remove the influence of designated data while preserving the model's behavior on information that should be retained. While a growing body of work investigates this objective in autoregressive large language models, machine unlearning remains underexplored in diffusion language models (DLMs). DLMs generate text through iterative denoising, exposing partially masked states whose internal representations change throughout the generation process. This raises a DLM-specific question: can selective forgetting improve by identifying forget-data-associated features and adapting their suppression across denoising stages? We conduct a controlled investigation of this question in LLaDA-8B-Instruct. To evaluate the unlearning of knowledge plausibly encoded during pre-training, we use WMDP as our forget-domain benchmark. Using top-k sparse autoencoders and denoising-state replay, we compare static and stage-adaptive feature suppression. We find substantial shifts in forget-data-associated features across denoising stages, but tracking these dynamics alone does not reliably improve the forget-retain trade-off at the evaluated operating points. Together, our study provides an initial empirical foundation for developing and evaluating machine unlearning as a post-training privacy mechanism in DLMs.

items.title: How do you calculate option SL and TP premiums from underlying chart levels before entering a trade?
items.raw_text: I'm trading BTC options on Delta Exchange, and I'm trying to find an easy way to calculate the option's SL and TP premium before entering a trade. My strategy is based on price action. I first analyze the BTC chart, identify my entry, stop-loss (SL) and take-profit (TP) levels, and then choose an option to trade. For example: Option: 60200 CE (Buy) BTC market price: $59,000 Option entry premium: $460 Delta: 0.40 My underlying SL: $57,356 My underlying TP: $61,000 My problem is that I need to convert my underlying BTC SL and TP levels into option premium prices. I tried using the delta formula: Option price change = Delta × BTC price change But it gives me a negative SL premium because the BTC price movement is large. I understand that delta changes as the underlying price moves, so this method isn't accurate for larger movements. I also came across Black-Scholes, but it seems complicated for calculating this before every trade. My questions: Is there an easy way to calculate the estimated option premium at my underlying SL and TP levels? Is there any calculator or tool that can do this without manually calculating Black-Scholes? Can I calculate the option's SL and TP premiums using its IV, expiry, strike and current premium? How do experienced options traders calculate their RPT and position size before entering a trade? I want to know my potential loss and calculate the correct quantity/lots BEFORE placing an order. Any practical method, calculator or tool recommendation would be appreciated.

items.one_line_summary: BTC 期权用标的 SL/TP 反推权利金时，Delta×价格变动在 2.8% 跌幅下算出 -198 权利金，需改用 BS/IV 重定价
items.technical_summary: 帖子问的是：先看 BTC 价格行为定好标的入场、止损 57356、止盈 61000，再买 60200 CE、权利金 460、Delta 0.40，如何在下单前把标的 SL/TP 换算成期权权利金。直接用 Delta×标的变动会把止损权利金算成约 -198，原因是标的下跌 2.8% 时 Delta 会随价格变化，线性近似忽略了 Gamma。可行做法是用 Black-Scholes 或期权计算器，输入 IV、到期、行权价和标的 SL/TP 重新估值，再用入场权利金与止损权利金之差计算每张风险并反推仓位。原文没有社区回答或工具推荐，也没有讨论 IV 跳升、滑点和合约乘数。
key_points: 原文无回答；最有价值的信息是具体算例暴露了核心问题：BTC 从 59000 跌到 57356 仅 2.8%，用 Delta 0.40 线性换算会把 460 权利金算成 -198，必须重定价。
用 Black-Scholes 或期权计算器输入 IV、到期、行权价、当前标的价，分别算 SL/TP 对应理论权利金；每张风险=入场权利金-止损权利金，止损权利金最低取 0，再按账户风险预算反推张数。
固定 IV 会低估 BTC 急跌时 IV 跳升和偏斜影响，且未计 Delta Exchange 合约乘数、手续费和滑点；线性 Delta 在大幅波动下会系统性失真。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模 / 仓位管理；执行 / 交易成本
items.possible_use_case: 在 Delta Exchange 下单前用 Python 的 py_vollib 或自写 BS 函数，输入 BTC 现价、行权价 60200、到期时间、IV，计算 57356 和 61000 对应的理论权利金；按账户 1% 风险除以（460-SL 权利金）×合约乘数得到张数，并加 IV 上升 10 个点的压力测试。
items.limitations: 这是社区提问，原文没有回答、回测或工具实测，需用数据验证后才能用于研究结论；固定 IV 的 BS 重定价忽略波动率微笑、跳跃风险和流动性滑点，BTC 期权实盘偏差可能明显。

items.title: Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges
items.raw_text: Public Citizen traced 66 of 130 qualifying wallets to exchanges that restrict US users, raising questions over who is attending Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday.
items.abstract: Public Citizen traced 66 of 130 qualifying wallets to exchanges that restrict US users, raising questions over who is attending Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday.
items.one_line_summary: Public Citizen 链上追踪：特朗普晚宴 130 个合格钱包中 66 个来自限制美国用户交易所，TRUMP 持有者来源透明度受质疑
items.technical_summary: 特朗普 memecoin 晚宴的参会资格由持有 TRUMP 代币的钱包决定，争议点是谁实际控制这些钱包。Public Citizen 对 130 个合格钱包做链上归属追踪，发现其中 66 个可追溯至限制美国用户使用的交易所。这个比例意味着近半数合格地址可能并非美国本土用户直接持有，也可能通过海外交易所托管或中转。报道未给出这些钱包的 TRUMP 持仓量、交易时间或晚宴前后价格反应。
key_points: Public Citizen 追踪 130 个合格钱包，66 个可追溯至限制美国用户的交易所，占比约 50.8%。
对加密量化：可把交易所来源与钱包集中度纳入 TRUMP 事件驱动因子，监控晚宴前后大额转账和净流。
交易所归属依赖链上启发式，可能误判；报道缺少持仓量、成交量和价格数据，不能单独构成交易信号。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模 / 因子信号
items.possible_use_case: 可作为 TRUMP memecoin 事件驱动策略的持有者结构风险信号：晚宴前后监控这 66 个钱包的转入转出与交易所净流，用于判断潜在抛压和波动放大。
items.limitations: 仅基于公开钱包归属推断，交易所归属可能误判；新闻未提供价格、成交量、持仓集中度或链上净流入数据，事件影响需结合市场数据独立验证。

items.one_line_summary: Ackman 公开警告美联储12月加息25个基点是「错误」，提示 BTC 在 FOMC 窗口的宏观 beta 风险
items.technical_summary: 文章讨论的是美联储12月议息会议的政策路径而非资产定价模型。市场共识与经济学家预测为加息25个基点，Pershing Square 创始人 Bill Ackman 公开将这一动作定性为「错误」，隐含指向紧缩过度触发衰退的风险。对加密市场而言，这类宏观表态通过美债收益率与美元流动性渠道传导至 BTC 等风险资产，构成 FOMC 前后的波动来源。原文未给出 Ackman 的完整论据、发言时间点或任何市场反应数据，仅有观点层面的定性与一个政策数字（25bp）。
key_points: 市场与经济学家共识为美联储12月加息25个基点，Ackman 公开警告该决策是「错误」并可能引发衰退。
加密交易者可在12月 FOMC 前后把 BTC 与美债收益率、美元指数的滚动相关性作为事件窗口的风险敞口调节依据。
原文仅两句话重复，无 Ackman 具体论据、无发言时间、无市场反应数据；实际决议仍取决于 CPI 与非农，警告本身不构成可交易信号。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模；因子 / alpha 信号（宏观事件驱动）
items.possible_use_case: 把12月 FOMC 决议日加入事件日历，在决议前3个交易日下调 BTC 净多头敞口或买入跨式期权做多隐含波动率，决议后按点阵图与实际加息幅度之差做方向回归。
items.limitations: 这是新闻转述而非研究结论，原文信息密度极低，缺乏 Ackman 的完整论证、发言时间和市场即时反应数据，摘要基于定性描述；加息预期本身已被市场定价，事件落地后可能出现「预期兑现」的反向走势；社区/媒体观点需用收益率曲线与资金流数据独立验证后才能进入模型。

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
items.raw_text: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.
items.abstract: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.
items.one_line_summary: Chainflip 确认 1200 万美元被盗，悬赏 10% 追回 90% 资金
items.technical_summary: Chainflip 确认约 1200 万美元被盗，要求攻击者在 11 月 23 日前归还 90%（约 1080 万美元），可保留 10%（约 120 万美元）赏金，并承诺按白帽恢复处理、撤销执法投诉。对量化交易者而言，这直接构成跨链 DEX 协议的智能合约与流动性风险事件，可能影响 FLIP 代币价格、LP 头寸和跨链 swap 执行。原文未披露攻击向量和资金追回进展。
key_points: Chainflip 确认 1200 万美元被盗，攻击者若在 11 月 23 日前归还 90%（约 1080 万美元）可保留 10%（约 120 万美元）赏金。
持有 FLIP 或 Chainflip LP 头寸的量化账户应检查敞口，事件未明朗前可减仓或撤池，并监控链上资金回流与跨链 swap 量变化。
仅来自 CoinTelegraph 单篇报道，未附攻击向量、链上交易哈希或项目方完整声明；资金能否归还、截止日后是否转向执法仍不确定。

items.title: Chainflip’s losses climb to $12 million after protocol discloses 122.9 BTC theft, offers hacker bounty
items.raw_text: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return the remainder of the $12 million in stolen BTC, ETH, and stablecoins by Monday.
items.abstract: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return the remainder of the $12 million in stolen BTC, ETH, and stablecoins by Monday.
items.one_line_summary: Chainflip 跨链协议被盗 122.9 BTC，含 ETH 与稳定币累计损失 1200 万美元，10% 白帽赏金限期周一
items.technical_summary: 跨链协议 Chainflip 发生资产被盗，官方披露的攻击损失为 122.9 BTC，并连同 ETH 与稳定币，使总损失规模达到 1200 万美元。协议公开向攻击者提出 10% 白帽赏金（约 120 万美元），条件是周一前归还剩余被盗资产。事件的核心量化含义不在价格方向，而在跨链执行环节：当这类协议的池子被抽走 BTC，跨链兑换的深度、滑点和报价有效性会突然改变，依赖该通道做跨链搬砖、DEX-CEX 价差或做市库存回转的策略，会在同一时间段内遭遇找不到对手方或成交价格严重不利的情况。
key_points: 被盗 122.9 BTC，叠加 ETH 与稳定币后总损失 1200 万美元，10% 赏金约 120 万美元限周一归还
跨链池 BTC 被抽走会同时打击深度与报价，事件窗口内应下调该场所额度并切换到替代通道
信息仅来自单一媒体转述，无链上哈希、地址与资金流向，1200 万美元的资产拆分口径未公布
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模 / 执行：跨链交易场所的对手方敞口、资金池深度和路由报价需要在事件期间临时重估。

items.limitations: 报道极为简短，缺少被盗交易的链上哈希、攻击合约、资金归集地址和具体被盗时间，因此无法做资金追踪或复现攻击路径；1200 万美元总损失里 BTC、ETH 与稳定币各自的占比未披露，10% 赏金是否已被接受也没有后续确认；此金额在 DeFi 攻击事件中属于中等规模，市场层面的价格影响可能被高估；新闻稿没有说明协议是否暂停跨链功能，实际流动性状态需自行查询链上和官方公告后再做决策。

items.technical_summary: BTC 在触及两年低点后单日反弹约 9%，重新站上 60,000 美元。本轮下跌触发约 18 亿美元杠杆仓位清算，其中多数为押注上涨的多头头寸，意味着下跌由多头拥挤平仓放大，而非空头主动进攻。清算完成后价格快速收复整数关口，市场焦点转向周一美股开盘，用来判断这是空头回补的技术性反弹，还是风险偏好真正修复。原文正文实际只有一句话，且与标题重复，具体清算分布、交易所构成与时间戳均未给出。
key_points: 18 亿美元杠杆仓位被清算，主体是多头，BTC 自两年低点反弹 9% 重回 60,000 美元上方。
多头清算峰值常对应短期底部，可用资金费率由正转负、未平仓合约骤降 20% 以上作为反转确认条件。
原文只有标题和一句重复正文，缺清算币种分布、交易所明细和精确时间，需用 Coinglass、各交易所强平数据交叉核对。

items.limitations: 原文信息密度极低，正文仅一句与标题重复的话，无法据此判断清算数据来源与统计口径；60,000 美元与「两年低点」的相对位置需用交易所 K 线核实；单一媒体报道，未区分永续与交割合约、也未知是否含跨交易所重复计算；反弹 9% 属事后描述，不构成样本外可验证结论。

items.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
items.raw_text: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.
items.abstract: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.
items.one_line_summary: Block 旗下 AI 代码扫描器 Loupe 在 Bitcoin Core 中挖出 DoS 漏洞：重复同一 ID 5 万次可拖停节点，修复已于周五上线
items.technical_summary: Bitcoin Core 存在一条可被构造消息触发的拒绝服务路径：把同一个 ID 重复发送 5 万次，即可让节点陷入停滞。漏洞由 Block 旗下 Spiral 团队的开源扫描器 Loupe 定位，该工具用 AI agent 遍历 bitcoin 代码库做自动化审计，而非依赖人工逐行审阅。Bitcoin Core 已于周五发布修复版本。整条链路的意义在于：AI agent 首次在比特币核心客户端这类高 stakes 代码上产出可落地的安全发现，把「AI 做代码审计」从演示推进到实际修补。
key_points: AI 扫描器 Loupe 定位到 Bitcoin Core 的 DoS 路径：同一 ID 重复 5 万次即可使节点停滞，官方修复于周五发布。
节点停滞会同时打断交易所充提、行情推送和链上数据抓取，量化团队需在运维层加入区块高度落后、RPC 超时率和 mempool 异常的自动告警与熔断。
原文未给出漏洞编号、受影响版本范围、触发报文格式，也未说明是否已有在野利用；AI 扫描器的误报率与代码覆盖率同样未量化，发现本身仍需人工复核。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模（节点/基础设施可用性） + 研究工具 / 工作流提效（AI agent 代码审计）
items.possible_use_case: 把「节点停滞」写进实盘监控与熔断规则：当自建 Bitcoin 节点的区块高度落后全网超过 2 个块、或 RPC 超时率 5 分钟内超过 10% 时，自动暂停依赖该节点的下单与充提套利策略，并切换到备用节点或公共 RPC。
items.limitations: 原文只有两句话的正文，缺漏洞编号（CVE）、影响版本区间、PoC 与在野利用情况；未说明修复是否向后兼容以及全节点升级采用率，未升级节点仍暴露在风险中。Loupe 作为 AI agent 扫描器的漏报与误报没有量化数据，不能把「AI 发现」等同于审计完备。URL 时间戳标为 2026-11-21，与当前时间不符，需核对是否为占位或转载。这是新闻稿而非技术公告，缺乏可复现的验证材料。

items.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
items.raw_text: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.
items.abstract: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.
items.one_line_summary: 美国议员提议预测市场欺诈举报人可获罚金 10%–30%（门槛 100 万美元），抬高 Polymarket/Kalshi 类平台的操纵成本
items.technical_summary: 预测市场（事件合约）长期存在操纵和内幕交易取证困难的问题：单笔可疑交易获利可能只有几万美元，监管调查成本却远高于此。该提案仿照 SEC 举报人计划，用金钱激励内部人举报：在罚款金额超过 100 万美元的合格欺诈案件中，举报人可获得罚金的 10%–30%。若该提案进入立法，预测市场操纵的预期成本将显著上升，Kalshi、Polymarket 这类平台的做市商面对的逆向选择风险和信息不对称程度可能下降。原文只给出奖励区间（10%–30%）和罚金门槛（100 万美元）两个数字，未披露法案编号、发起人、适用平台范围与时间表。
key_points: 议员提议预测市场欺诈举报人可获罚金 10%–30%，仅适用于罚金超 100 万美元的案件，即单案罚金至少 100 万美元、举报人至少 10 万美元
对量化交易者而言，若落地将降低 Polymarket、Kalshi 事件合约的内幕交易与拉盘频率，做市价差可收窄，跨所与跨合约套利窗口更依赖信息而非噪音；可将其作为监管事件加入日历
仅处于提案阶段，原文无法案编号、无发起议员姓名、无适用交易所界定（是否覆盖加密结算的 Polymarket 不明），且正文两句话完全重复，信息密度极低
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模（预测市场操纵与合规风险）+ 因子 / alpha 信号（事件合约定价效率与跨所价差）
items.possible_use_case: 可作为预测市场事件合约做市与跨所套利策略的监管跟踪项：在 Polymarket/Kalshi 上监控大额异动单与价格偏离幅度，在法案进入委员会表决或正式提出时，下调事件合约挂单规模与最大持仓上限，等执法细则明确后再恢复报价。
items.limitations: 原文只有两句话且完全重复，没有法案编号、发起人、适用平台范围和立法进度，无法判断通过概率；美国提案到成法平均耗时数月且多数夭折。该提案不直接改变任何代币价格或链上数据，不应单独作为交易信号，需与国会记录（congress.gov）交叉核实后再使用。

items.title: Kalshi faces Monday hearing on New York order it says would shut down its exchange nationwide
items.raw_text: Kalshi, which is headquartered in New York, has said the order would shut it down nationwide, though NY's AG said that's not her goal.
items.abstract: Kalshi, which is headquartered in New York, has said the order would shut it down nationwide, though NY's AG said that's not her goal.
items.one_line_summary: 纽约州禁令听证会周一开庭，Kalshi 称将全国关停交易所，加密事件合约交易场所面临消失风险
items.technical_summary: 纽约州针对 Kalshi 下达的禁令进入司法程序，周一举行听证会，核心争议是州级监管能否对一家 CFTC 体系内的预测市场交易所行使管辖权。Kalshi 总部位于纽约，其立场是该禁令一旦生效将导致其全国业务停摆，而纽约总检察长公开表示关停全国交易所并非其目的。对量化交易者的直接含义是：Kalshi 上以 BTC、ETH 价格阈值为标的的事件合约，其做市、跨场所套利和订单簿数据管道都绑定在这一场所的存续上。需要注意的是，原文正文仅将标题段落重复两次，除听证时间（周一）与双方立场外没有提供案号、禁令条款、判决时间表等任何细节。
key_points: 纽约州禁令周一开庭，Kalshi 称将导致全国交易所停运，纽约总检察长称关停全国并非其目标
Kalshi 加密价格事件合约的做市与套利需预备迁移方案，听证前后盘口深度可能骤降

items.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
items.raw_text: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.
items.abstract: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.
items.one_line_summary: ETH 财库公司 BTCS 向 SEC 披露其 5400 万美元 Aave 贷款面临清算，十日内已偿还约 1000 万美元
items.technical_summary: 比特币财库模式扩散到 ETH 后，杠杆链条开始承压：BTCS 以持有的 ETH 作为抵押，在 Aave 上借款。由于 ETH 价格下跌压缩抵押品价值，BTCS 向 SEC 披露其约 5400 万美元的 Aave 贷款存在被清算风险。作为应对，公司在十天内将报告的 Aave 债务削减约 1000 万美元，但剩余头寸仍暴露在价格继续下跌的清算阈值之下。这类披露第一次把「上市公司 ETH 财库杠杆」和「DeFi 借贷协议清算引擎」直接连成一条可观测的风险传导路径。
key_points: BTCS 约 5400 万美元的 Aave 贷款进入 SEC 风险披露，十日内已偿还约 1000 万美元，ETH 下跌仍压抵押品
可把 ETH 财库类上市公司的链上健康因子、清算价列入监控，作为 ETH 下行时的强制平仓压力信号
原文仅转述披露，未给清算价、抵押率、健康因子，且正文与标题重复，具体头寸需用 Aave 链上数据核实

items.possible_use_case: 把 BTCS 等 ETH 财库公司的 Aave 借款地址、健康因子和清算价接入链上监控面板；当健康因子降至 1.2 以下时，生成 ETH 强制平仓压力告警，作为日内波动放大和做空波动率的信号输入
items.limitations: 原文不足百字，且正文与标题内容重复，未披露具体清算阈值、抵押资产构成、借款利率与到期结构；只有单一公司样本，不能代表全部 ETH 财库杠杆规模；SEC 披露与链上实际头寸之间存在时间差，实际债务可能已被部分偿还；这是新闻转述而非链上原始数据，结论必须用 Aave 合约数据和 8-K 原文交叉验证后才能用于研究或交易决策

items.raw_text: Chainflip's FLIP token dropped 34% in price in the wake of the apparently automated attack, per The Block's price data.
items.abstract: Chainflip's FLIP token dropped 34% in price in the wake of the apparently automated attack, per The Block's price data.
items.one_line_summary: Chainflip 金库因疑似私钥泄露被转走 486 万美元，FLIP 代币随即暴跌 34%
items.technical_summary: 问题：Chainflip 的金库遭到疑似私钥泄露的攻击，攻击过程看上去是自动化执行的，约 486 万美元资产被转出。方法/数据：报道引用了 The Block 自有价格数据来衡量代币反应，未披露链上交易哈希或被盗资产明细。结论：FLIP 代币价格在事件曝光后下跌 34%，属于典型的安全事件引发的单币种急跌。对量化而言，这是一次可用于校准「安全事件冲击衰减曲线」的样本：34% 的单日跌幅和 486 万美元的损失规模，可以计算冲击幅度与损失规模的比例、成交量和流动性撤出的速度。
key_points: FLIP 代币在疑似私钥泄露事件后下跌 34%，金库被盗金额约 486 万美元，攻击过程呈自动化特征。
持 FLIP 或为 FLIP 做市的账户需立刻检查敞口与抵押品折算；同类依赖中心化密钥管理的跨链/金库协议可能被按板块整体抛售，可对这批代币做事件传染性跟踪。
原文仅有标题级信息，未说明攻击路径（私钥泄露，还是合约或签名逻辑漏洞）、被盗资产币种、是否有赔偿或回购方案、链上交易哈希也未公开，价格跌幅也仅来自 The Block 单一数据源，因此无法据此刻画完整的攻击链与二次风险。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模 / 事件驱动 alpha 信号：需要重新评估跨链、金库类协议的密钥托管风险溢价，并捕捉代币价格的瞬时冲击与后续反弹。
items.possible_use_case: 把「协议被盗/私钥泄露」作为一个事件标签接入链上监控；当同类协议（跨链桥、金库托管）发生异常转出时，在 15 分钟内对事件币以及同板块代币做空或多空配对，用 34% 这类历史冲击幅度设定止盈止损；同时把 FLIP 从做市白名单和抵押品清单中临时剔除。

items.abstract: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.
items.one_line_summary: XRP 单日跌 10% 跌破 11 月前低，多头清算主导且 ETF 资产跌破 10 亿美元
items.technical_summary: XRP 在周六加密市场抛售中下跌 10%，跌破 11 月前低，触发以多头为主的清算，杠杆多头被动平仓放大跌势。XRP 相关 ETF 资产规模跌破 10 亿美元，显示机构资金流入放缓或撤离。技术指标同时指向进一步走弱。对量化交易者，这是清算驱动型动量与波动事件，应结合资金费率、未平仓合约和 ETF 流数据判断多头拥挤度。
key_points: XRP 单日跌 10%，跌破 11 月前低，XRP 清算中多头占多数；ETF 资产规模跌破 10 亿美元。
可监控 XRP 永续资金费率、未平仓合约与 ETF 净流入，作为多头拥挤度反转和日内动量信号。
原文未披露具体清算金额、资金费率与 ETF 净流出数值，且仅为单一媒体快讯，需用交易所和链上数据复核。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模、因子 / alpha 信号
items.possible_use_case: 将 XRP 跌破月内前低、多头清算占比和 ETF 资产规模跌破 10 亿美元组合成加密多头拥挤度预警因子，用于日内降低杠杆或过滤抄底信号。
items.limitations: 这是市场新闻快讯，未给出清算总额、资金费率、ETF 日度净流和链上地址变化；事件驱动信号易受反弹和流动性枯竭影响，需独立验证后才能用于研究结论。
